citation: Reaction-wheel harmonic comb with fundamental amplitude ~ wheel-speed^2 and structural cage modes ~300-480 Hz across surveyed CubeSat wheels, 400-480 Hz for the largest (Shields et al. 2017, JoSS). Pointing-stability figures 0.7/8/12 mas are the requirement / ACS class / passive-jitter design class quoted for WFIRST-CGI (NASA NTRS 20200002690, Dennehy & Alvarez-Salazar 2019). Default is a deliberately coarse upper-end residual.
notes: At the cited ~12 mas passive-jitter class, this preset's optics (~0.3 urad/px) give ~0.2 px RMS: deeply sub-pixel. The 103 mas default is a deliberately coarse ~10x figure (~1.7 px RMS) so rendered effects are demonstrable; override residual_rms for a specific mission class.
